messages:
maya: kicking off ap-southeast1 burn-up now. want to run load/soak + autoscale tuning before handoff to oncall. following the runbook but calling out a few open items.

jordan: thanks. can you confirm node types & quotas? H100 pool committed? if not, we'll fallback to A100 and expect higher p99.

maya: H100 pool reserved 12 GPUs (dedicated), can burst to 8 A100 spot if needed. quota check ok for now. planning: 1) 4h ramp (spike to 70% target) 2) 48h soak at ~45% avg GPU util 3) 1h high-burst tests.

sam: sounds good. i'd add a cold-start-heavy pattern for kv-cache miss rate. when cache miss > 20% we see token/sec drop and queue buildup.

leo: autoscaler params i'd test:
```
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 80
scale_metric: "gpu_util_avg"
target_value: 55
cooldown_period: 90s
scale_up_rate: 1.5x
sustained_window: 120s
```
start conservative on scale_up_rate to avoid overshoot.

ana: also guard against backend queue saturation: set request queue limit = 1000 and add alert if queue_len > 800 for 2m.

deploy-bot: smoke tests passed for ap-southeast1 (commit ab12cd3) :tada:

jordan: network note — we saw MTU fragmentation on last rehearsal between cloud-peering and onprem-proxy. validate MTU=1438 and BGP path pref for control-plane subnets.

maya: noted. i'll run the network validation script: `./infra/tools/validate_peers.sh ap-southeast1` and post results.

sam: loadrunner commands i'll use:
`k6 run --env TARGET=ap-southeast1 scripts/ramp.js --vus 200 --duration 4h`
and soak harness:
`./testctl soak --region ap-southeast1 --avg-gpu 45 --duration 48h`

leo: monitoring dashboards to watch: infra/gpu-util, infra/gpu-queue, runtime/p99-token-latency, network/bgp-stats, cost/est-per-hour. set a temporary alert: cost/spike if spend > $X/hour for 30m.

maya: final handoff checklist: infra sign-off (jordan), sres sign-off (sam), update runbook with final autoscale params, create incident channel `#inc-ap-sg1` and add oncall rotation. will post when soak starts. :eyes:

jordan: +1. i'll be available for the initial ramp. :thumbsup:

sam: i'll own soak watch & callbacks. create a doc in drive with test artifacts.

ana: added queue alert and grafana panels. ping me if you want an extra dashboard widget for kv-hit-rate.

maya: starting ramp in 10m. will update thread with results. thanks all.
